name: com.ogs.telemetry.unity
description: Broadcast OGS-TS motion/event telemetry over UDP multicast to motion platforms, haptic hardware, and dashboards on the local network. Declare channels with required units, bind game values, publish.

samples.description: A wired demo vehicle (kinematic cube on a circle with rpm/speed/headlights channels) and the GameObject > OGS-TS > Create Demo Scene menu.
